# AgenticThat

> AgenticThat runs AI agents for the online side of a business from one workspace: AI-built websites, WhatsApp and Telegram messaging, an AI phone receptionist, public-data research, and scheduled social publishing.

Website: https://agenticthat.com/
Contact: agenticthat@gmail.com
Address: Vivekananda Nagar, Dilsukhnagar, Hyderabad, Telangana 500060, India

## Products (live)

- AI Website Studio: creates three responsive, business-specific website designs from one short brief, then delivers and publishes the chosen design.
- WhatsApp and Telegram Messaging: manages contacts, campaigns, templates, inbox replies and outbound messages.
- AI Phone Front Desk: an AI receptionist that answers calls with knowledge of the business, qualifies the caller, captures the lead and prepares a summary.
- Social media posting: creates, schedules and tracks posts to Instagram, Facebook, X, LinkedIn, YouTube and Reddit.
- Public data research: collects public Instagram and Facebook profiles, Pages, posts, reels, comments and engagement counts as JSON or CSV.
- PDF Studio: free browser-based PDF tools (merge, split, organize, convert, compress, edit) at https://agenticthat.com/tools/pdf

## Coming soon

- SEO and AI visibility tools: keyword research, website audits, AI visibility checks, content and profile optimization.
- Replies and comments: reviewable engagement on posts across social channels.

## How it runs

- Managed execution for supported work.
- A Local Companion app for account-bound browser sessions, so social account passwords stay on the customer's own machine.
- Human review and visible sessions keep important actions accountable.
